name: Cantilune
author: Cantilune contributors
description: Creates daily playlists for 30 everyday situations (gym, driving, cooking, studying, sleep …) with selectable presets and a song selection based on genre, BPM, ReplayGain, favorites, ratings and listening history.

playlistPrefix.title: Prefix
playlistPrefix.description: Placed before every playlist name, e.g. 🎧, 🌙 or ✨.

showPresetInName.title: Show preset in playlist name (e.g. "Gym Hardstyle ⚡")

defaultUser.title: Owner
defaultUser.description: User who owns the playlists. Empty = first permitted admin.

publicPlaylists.title: Make playlists public (visible to all users)

runOnStartup.title: Create missing or changed playlists right after saving

maxPerArtist.title: Max. per artist
maxPerArtist.description: Songs per artist per playlist, 0 = unlimited

avoidRecentDays.title: Avoid played (days)
avoidRecentDays.description: Pick recently played songs less often, 0 = off

historyDays.title: Avoid repeats (days)
historyDays.description: Pick songs from recent playlists less often, 0 = previous playlist only

skipInterludes.title: Skip short intros, skits and interludes

excludeGenres.title: Never use these genres
excludeGenres.description: Applies to all playlists unless a preset explicitly includes the genre.

removeAllPlaylists.title: Delete all Cantilune playlists and pause the plugin
removeAllPlaylists.description: Enable and save before uninstalling. Navidrome does not notify plugins when they are removed, so Cantilune cannot clean up afterwards.

audience.title: Playlists for
audience.description: Shared: one playlist owned by the owner, based on the owner's favorites and history. Personal: a private playlist for every permitted user, based on that user's own data.

playlistLanguage.title: Playlist language
playlistLanguage.description: Language of situation and preset names in playlist names and comments

weightGenre.title: Genre fit (%)
weightGenre.description: How strongly exact genre matches are preferred, 0 = ignore

weightTempo.title: Tempo, energy, mood (%)
weightTempo.description: Influence of BPM, ReplayGain and mood tags, 0 = ignore

weightPreference.title: Favorites & ratings (%)
weightPreference.description: Influence of favorites, ratings, play counts and the selection mode, 0 = ignore

weightVariety.title: Variety (%)
weightVariety.description: How strongly recently played songs and recent playlists are avoided, 0 = ignore

learnFromEdits.title: Learn from playlist edits
learnFromEdits.description: Songs you remove from a Cantilune playlist are avoided for 60 days, songs you add are preferred

logDetails.title: Log why each song was chosen

dryRun.title: Preview only (log the selection, do not change playlists)

archiveDays.title: Archive (days)
archiveDays.description: Keep replaced playlists as private archive with date, 0 = delete immediately

customSituations.title: Custom situations
customSituations.description: Any number of additional situations with your own filters.

subsonicapi.reason: Read songs and their metadata (getRandomSongs, getGenres, getPlaylist) and create, publish and replace Cantilune playlists

users.reason: Perform Subsonic API calls on behalf of the configured playlist owners

scheduler.reason: Regenerate playlists daily at the configured time

kvstore.reason: Remember recent songs and playlist edits so playlists do not repeat and follow your changes
